name: Harming People
overview: Scripture firmly commands against harming others, as seen in the clear injunction 'Thou shalt not kill' (Exodus 20:13). God’s heart is one of healing and restoration, tenderly binding the brokenhearted and upholding those who suffer (Psalms 147:3; Isaiah 41:10). Even when faced with rejection or persecution for Christ’s sake, believers are assured of God's sustaining presence and His plans for peace and hope rather than harm (Psalms 27:10; Jeremiah 29:11; Matthew 5:11).
